# Queer Between the Lines (QBTL)

Queer Between the Lines (QBTL) is a queer-led book club for thoughtful reading, conversation, and community — with monthly reads, notes, and reflections.

## Canonical URL
https://clarity-by-jayden.github.io/queerlines/

## Key pages
- Home: https://clarity-by-jayden.github.io/queerlines/
- Notes (Sep 2026): https://clarity-by-jayden.github.io/queerlines/notes/2026-09/
- Privacy policy: https://clarity-by-jayden.github.io/queerlines/privacy-policy/
